full_name: Rose McDermott | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2010–2011 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Brown University
bio: Rose McDermott is a professor of political science at Brown University who is interested in exploring the psychological, biological, and genetic aspects of political decision making and behavior.
